summary: Curtiss-Wright filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 disclosing that its Board authorized an additional $510 million share repurchase, lifting total availability to $700 million (including $190 million remaining under prior authorizations). The company also adopted a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to buy $100 million ratably through October 30, 2026, leaving roughly $600 million afterward. No price, premium, or expiration is stated; repurchases may use open-market, accelerated, block, or negotiated methods. Watch execution pace and buyback support for the stock.
